## Description {#details}

The <code>include/micro-os-plus</code> folder serves as the primary location for the public header files of the µTest++ testing framework, providing the main interface for users and integrators.

This folder contains declarations for all fundamental components of the framework, including test suite and test case management, test runner control, result reporting, mathematical utilities, type traits, user-defined literals, operators, reflection utilities, and essential internal mechanisms.

By consolidating all public API definitions within this folder, the project maintains a clear distinction from implementation details (located in the <code>src</code> folder), thereby supporting modularity, maintainability, and straightforward integration.

To utilise the full functionality of the µTest++ framework, users should include the <code><Link to="/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus-h">micro-test-plus.h</Link></code> header from this folder in their projects.
